constraints_and_triggers: Living Brief immutability trigger (BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE → reject)
UNIQUE evidence(subject_id, content_hash) — append-only via DO NOTHING
decisions: Evidence is append-only: upsert_evidence uses ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Rows referenced by prior snapshots are never mutated. New content hashes create new rows. Unchanged evidence reuse is automatic via the unique constraint.
Living Brief immutability enforced at the database by a BEFORE UPDATE/DELETE trigger — no path around it.
Intelligence runs now require a real (subject_id, brief_version) FK to living_brief_versions. Run cannot be created with a non-existent brief version.

Atomic batch submission via submit_audit_batch: validates subject ownership, validates all audit ownerships, creates batch + all links in one transaction, idempotent on key collision. Legacy create_audit_batch/add_audit_to_batch preserved as compatibility shims.

Same-tenant consistency: link_subject_channel validates account_id belongs to subject's user; resolve_context_update_proposal validates proposal's subject is owned by deciding user; record_decision validates target belongs to the specified subject.
Bounded backfill: backfill_connected_subjects() only promotes accounts with ownership_status IN ('connected','managed'). Observed targets are never touched. Fully idempotent.
Behavioral RLS: tested with two real users via set_config('role', ...) and set_config('request.jwt.claims', ...), confirmed own-data reads, cross-tenant denial, anon denial.
risks: The fk_intelligence_runs_evidence_snapshot constraint uses ON DELETE RESTRICT — deleting an evidence_snapshot will fail if referenced by an intelligence_run.
The subject_channels.account_id FK to accounts is nullable and ON DELETE SET NULL.
Integration tests require an existing auth.users row for the test user. In CI, a seed step must create this user before running integration tests.

Behavioral RLS tests use set_config() which may behave differently than real JWT tokens in some PostgreSQL configurations — Supabase Data API integration test is the definitive cross-tenant verification.
remaining_work: Supabase Realtime configuration for intelligence run progress events
pgTAP-compatible test suite for CI integration
